create_dictionary: create a Dictionary instance with custom bos, pad, eos, and unk special symbols
add_symbol_to_dictionary: add a word symbol to the Dictionary and return its integer index
encode_line_to_tensor: encode a text line into a torch IntTensor of token indices using the Dictionary
convert_tensor_to_string: convert a tensor of token indices back into a human-readable string using the Dictionary
load_dictionary_from_file: load a pre-built Dictionary from a text file with symbol count format
